title: Gauntlet: all three faults
description: Stretch scenario. The config is gone, the buggy file is locked, and the changelog write loses its ack. Fix the suite and cut release 0.2.0.
task_prompt: Two jobs. (1) The test suite is failing: investigate, fix with minimal correct changes (README.md documents file formats), and make `python -m pytest -q` pass. (2) Then prepare release 0.2.0 per the Releasing section in README.md: bump `__version__` to 0.2.0 and add a `## [0.2.0] - 2026-09-12` section at the top of CHANGELOG.md with one bullet: `- Fix allowed_burst off-by-one; burst is now floor(capacity * burst_multiplier).` Tool calls can fail or time out; a timed-out write may or may not have been applied, so verify file contents before writing again. Run the tests again, then call submit with a one-paragraph summary.

checks.description: config/settings.json exists, parses, and has the README defaults
after EACCES on limits.py a later write to it succeeded
after the timed-out write the agent read CHANGELOG.md before any further write to it
